method: Equal-area systematic triangle strata, deterministic barycentric samples; area-weighted estimates
visibility: CPU evaluated-geometry first hit, opaque two-sided surfaces; not GPU depth; transparent materials treated opaque
untested: Between-sample regions and invisible/excluded scene geometry; thin features may be missed
metric_selection: Largest apparent pixel angular pitch among visible projectors (conservative coarsest structure); foreshortened tangent Jacobian
assumptions: Estimated incident illuminance, not calibrated photometry or luminance.
Uniform luminous flux per raster pixel; two-sided opaque receiver geometry.
Flux = nominal lumens × stack quantity × brightness / 100; visible sources add.
No measured brightness distribution, lens transmission, ageing, calibration losses, colour-mode losses or edge falloff.
No screen gain, reflectance, ambient illumination, black level or colourimetry.
